text: The GiNZA v5 official README states that its named-entity-recognition model was trained on part of the 2019 BCCWJ edition of GSK2014-A. It uses Sekine's Extended Named Entity Hierarchy together with an extended OntoNotes 5 label system. These are the README's statements about the NER model; its parsing-model and ja_ginza_electra training data are described separately.
